description: Code, stored results and analysis scripts for the paper "From Regime Shift to Redundancy: Boundary Conditions for Swarm-Based Feature Selection". The code extends Orthogonal Particle Swarm Optimisation with Crossover (OrPSOC) to non-stationary data with self-triggered and detector-triggered adaptation, and evaluates it against an all-features baseline, other swarm selectors (correlation-guided PSO, Taguchi chaotic binary PSO, hybrid PSO/differential evolution, binary whale optimisation) and filter or embedded selectors (mRMR, LASSO, RFE) under one walk-forward cross-validation protocol. It covers a synthetic benchmark with known signal features, financial datasets built from public sources, a dimensionality ladder and synthetic width sweep, a nested cross-validation analysis of the regularisation penalty, regime-change detector comparisons and two non-financial benchmarks. Every table and figure in the paper can be regenerated in minutes from the stored results, and every experiment can be re-run from the public data sources.
